grammarFocus: 过去进行时入门；when / while；who / which / that 定语从句入门。
title: A Community Festival
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，然后回答问题。这是一个模拟的英语学习材料，不是官方考试。请仔细阅读短文，并根据短文内容选择或填写答案。
passage: Last year, my town had a community festival. It was a sunny day in May. Many people were working together to prepare for the festival. While some people were putting up decorations, others were cooking food. I was helping my friend, who was selling handmade crafts. The festival started at noon. There was a stage where a local band was playing music. People were dancing and singing. I saw a woman who was wearing a traditional dress. She was teaching children how to make paper flowers. The children were laughing and having fun. At 3 p.m., there was a cooking competition. The judges were three local chefs. They tasted many dishes. The winner was a young man who made a spicy noodle soup. He said he learned the recipe from his grandmother. Everyone clapped and cheered. In the evening, there was a lantern parade. People were carrying beautiful lanterns that they made themselves. The parade went along the main street. It was a wonderful day. I met many new friends and learned about different cultures. I am looking forward to next year's festival. Many visitors came from other towns. They were taking photos and talking to local people. Some children were playing games near the stage. A group of volunteers were giving free water to everyone. The festival ended at 9 p.m. with a big fireworks show. People were watching the sky and smiling. I felt proud of my town. It was a day full of joy and friendship.

grammar.title: 过去进行时与定语从句入门
grammar.explanation: 过去进行时表示过去某个时刻正在进行的动作，结构是was/were + 动词-ing。when和while常用来引导时间状语从句。who/which/that引导定语从句，用来修饰名词。
grammar.example: While some people were putting up decorations, others were cooking food.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that clearly shows one past action interrupting another past action.
options: I was reading a book when the phone rang.
I was reading a book when the phone was ringing.
While I was reading a book, the phone was ringing.
answers: I was reading a book when the phone rang.
questions.explanation: 选项1中，when引导的从句用一般过去时rang，表示一个短暂的动作打断了正在进行的动作was reading，这是典型的 interrupting action。选项2和3都用了过去进行时，表示两个动作同时进行，没有打断的含义。
questions.evidence: I was reading a book when the phone rang.

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that clearly shows two actions happening at the same time in the past, both expressed with past continuous.
options: While I was cooking, my brother was watching TV.
While I was cooking, my brother watched TV.
When I cooked, my brother watched TV.
answers: While I was cooking, my brother was watching TV.
questions.explanation: 选项1中，while引导的从句和主句都用了过去进行时(was cooking, was watching)，表示两个动作同时进行。选项2和3中有一个或两个动作使用了一般过去时，不能明确表示同时进行的持续动作。
questions.evidence: While I was cooking, my brother was watching TV.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct relative pronoun to complete the sentence: The woman ______ was wearing a traditional dress was teaching children.
questions.explanation: 先行词the woman指人，在定语从句中作主语，所以用who。which指物，that可以指人或物，但这里who更常用。
questions.evidence: I saw a woman who was wearing a traditional dress.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct relative pronoun to complete the sentence: The lanterns ______ they made were beautiful.
questions.explanation: 先行词the lanterns指物，在定语从句中作宾语，所以用which。who指人，whose表示所属关系。
questions.evidence: People were carrying beautiful lanterns that they made themselves.
